# Songwriting & AI Music Generation

Everything here is a guideline, not a rule. Art breaks rules on purpose.
Use what serves the song.

## Song structure
Common structures include ABABCB, AABA, ABAB and AAA. Use Intro, Verse,
Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Bridge and Outro only when they serve the emotion.

## Rhyme, meter and sound
Mix perfect, family, assonance, consonance and slant rhymes. Match stressed
syllables and read lyrics aloud to catch awkward meter.

## Emotional arc
Use contrast: sparse before dense, slow before fast, low before high. Map
energy across sections instead of keeping every section at the same intensity.

## Lyrics
Prefer concrete imagery and memorable hooks. Revise the first draft. Avoid
cliches and forced word order unless intentionally used as a stylistic device.

## Suno prompting
Describe genre + mood + era + instruments + vocal persona + production +
dynamics. Describe the musical journey, not only a genre list. Use structural
metatags such as [Verse], [Pre-Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge] and [Outro]. Keep
tags coherent and avoid artist names or trademarks when describing sound.

## Workflow
1. Define the emotional core and hook.
2. Draft raw material before locking the structure.
3. Fit lyrics to structure and meter.
4. Build the style description around the dynamic arc.
5. Add useful performance/structure tags.
6. Generate multiple variations and revise the strongest one.

## Important adaptation rule
When adapting an existing song, work from structure, syllable stress and
emotional function. Do not reproduce protected lyrics or present copied lines
as original work.
